nodes.title: The Field of Kurukshetra
nodes.historical_context: Arjuna stands on the Kurukshetra battlefield, overwhelmed by the sight of his relatives and teachers. Bhishma commands the Kaurava host.

nodes.title: Days 2-8: The Grinding Days
nodes.historical_context: For seven days the two armies grind against each other under Bhishma's command. Neither side breaks; the toll of attrition is what matters. Hold the line and keep your forces alive.

nodes.title: Krishna's Rage
nodes.historical_context: Krishna's anger flares as Bhishma's forces falter. He demands that Arjuna act decisively, threatening to abandon the field if his orders are ignored.

nodes.title: The Fall of Bhishma
nodes.historical_context: Bhishma's life wanes; his death is imminent. The battlefield pauses as Arjuna faces a canonical choice.
